Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { chunkMaxSize: 30, language: "python" };
  const result = process("def alpha():\n    pass\n\ndef beta():\n    pass\n\ndef gamma():\n    pass\n\ndef delta():\n    pass\n", config);
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.metrics?.totalLines);
  console.log(result.chunks);
}

void main();
```
